These sample files come from pylivemaker's test data
(https://github.com/pmrowla/pylivemaker, tests/data), GPL-3.0, by Peter
Rowlands and tinfoil. They are used unchanged to check Yakusu's LiveMaker
archive, script and text readers against pylivemaker's results.

- test.exe, test.dat: tiny archives (an exe-style one and a standalone one)
- save.dat: a LiveNovel save file from the LiveNovel tutorial game
- 00000001.lsb: a compiled LiveNovel scenario chart (LiveMaker 3)
- gamemain.lsb: a compiled game main chart (LiveMaker 3)
